name: WPA Global Scholarly Knowledge Layer
purpose: Continuously discover, verify, atomise and strategically reuse legally accessible scholarly knowledge across the WPA Institute without bypassing source rights, academic verification or human authority.

discovery_infrastructure.rule: Restricted or login/paywall sources are discovery/manual-verification surfaces only unless lawful access and reuse permission are separately established.

rag_gate.additional_rule: Source must be verified, open or manually approved; fabricated metadata is prohibited; external-only discovery results are never treated as harvested full text.

reuse_domains.allowed: Use approved atoms to support, refine, challenge or open a doctrinal question.
reuse_domains.gate: HG4 for any Doctrine Kernel change

reuse_domains.allowed: Use cross-literature patterns, counterevidence and emerging research to inform strategic options and foresight.
reuse_domains.gate: Human strategic decision for consequential change

reuse_domains.allowed: Use empirical and methodological literature to test constructs, indicators, scoring anchors, evidence rules, fairness and robustness.
reuse_domains.gate: Methodology validation and Human Gate before v1.0 freeze

reuse_domains.allowed: Generate literature-grounded questions, gaps, comparative hypotheses and replication opportunities.
Use as attributed evidence, literature context, counterargument and research framing.
Translate approved findings into learning outcomes, concepts, scenarios and assessment prompts without copying protected expression.
Use verified recent and foundational literature to improve depth, triangulation and uncertainty framing.
Use approved atoms for source-literacy exercises, examples, quizzes and reading pathways.
Retrieve approved atoms as source-grounded context for synthesis, comparison and drafting.
Convert approved findings into attributed explainers and platform-specific drafts while preserving factual core and source trace.
reuse_domains.gate: Human publication approval unless a separately authorised bounded policy applies

strategic_synthesis_rule: Institutional DNA and Scholarly DNA must be compared, not conflated. Institutional practice answers what institutions do; scholarly evidence addresses what research, theory or documented analysis supports, contests or explains. WPA strategy should be strongest where both converge and should explicitly flag divergence.
rights_and_access_boundaries: No login, CAPTCHA, paywall or access-control bypass.
No silent full-text ingestion from external-only or restricted platforms.
No reproduction of protected books, chapters or articles beyond what is lawfully permitted.
Use metadata, abstracts, open text, public-domain/open-license text or manually authorised material according to the applicable rights.
Preserve authorship and source identity in every Scholarly Knowledge Atom.
Discovery does not equal permission to ingest or redistribute.
quality_rules: Citation count alone is not an authority judgment.
Prestige of journal, country or institution is not a substitute for methodological relevance and traceability.
Retractions, corrections and expressions of concern must propagate to dependent knowledge objects.
Conflicting studies are retained as conflict, not averaged into false consensus.
Recent evidence does not automatically supersede foundational evidence; relevance and methodological quality must be assessed.
Systematic reviews, standards and high-quality primary studies may have different evidentiary roles and must not be mechanically collapsed into one scale.

24_7_ready.note: The knowledge layer is architected for scheduled proactive discovery and queueing. Do not claim continuous execution until an active verified scheduler and source adapters are operational.

non_claims: Not a replacement for libraries, scholarly databases or peer review.
Not an autonomous Doctrine Kernel editor.
Not an intelligence or surveillance function.
